review: Rollback affects an active uncommitted transaction, not a previously committed edit; give an actionable history/recovery alternative. Handle an explicit correction to the earlier model explanation without defensiveness or inventing available history.

turns: My grid editor stores its levels in SQLite. Undo needs to survive closing the app.
